reviews.body: Arithmetic error. Ten years before 2025 is 2015 (401.01 ppm), not 2013 (396.74, which is twelve years back). Correct: (427.35 - 401.01)/10 = 2.634 ppm/yr (~2.63). The reported 3.06 divides a 12-year difference by 10. Fix the paragraph (and any note in README) and push; the hash, URL, fetch time, last year and mean check out against the raw file.
